25300.meaning1: cow to be tamed; cow in training

examples.text: godamakena, bhikkhave, godammo sārito ekaṃ'y'eva disaṃ dhāvati, puratthimaṃ vā pacchimaṃ vā uttaraṃ vā dakkhiṇaṃ vā.
tīṇi malāni timalaṃ, tīṇi phalāni tiphalaṃ, tayo lokā tilokaṃ, tayo daṇḍā tidaṇḍaṃ, catasso disā catuddisaṃ, pañca indriyāni pañc'indriyaṃ, satta godāvariyo sattagodāvaraṃ.
atthi vasā atthi dhenupā, godharaṇiyo paveṇiyo'pi atthi, usabho'pi gavampat'īdha atthi, atha ce patthayasī pavassa deva.
app'eva nām'etaṃ māluvābījaṃ moro vā gileyya, godhā vā khādeyya, mago vā khādeyya, davaḍāho vā ḍaheyya, vanakammikā vā uddhareyyuṃ, upacikā vā uṭṭhaheyyuṃ, abījaṃ vā pan'assā'ti.

te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… hatthilakkhaṇaṃ assalakkhaṇaṃ mahiṃsalakkhaṇaṃ usabhalakkhaṇaṃ golakkhaṇaṃ ajalakkhaṇaṃ meṇḍalakkhaṇaṃ kukkuṭalakkhaṇaṃ vaṭṭakalakkhaṇaṃ godhālakkhaṇaṃ
so assakassa visaye, aḷakassa samāsane, vasi godhāvarīkūle, uñchena ca phalena ca.

25310.notes: Theragāthā verse 51 (TH1.51, TH51) is attributed to him.

examples.text: chaṭṭham'pi kho āyasmā godhiko tamhā sāmayikāya cetovimuttiyā parihāyi. sattamam'pi kho āyasmā godhiko appamatto ātāpī pahit'atto viharanto sāmayikaṃ cetovimuttiṃ phusi.

25315.meaning1: shag cover; fleece; (comm) long haired black rug

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā pallaṅko gonak'atthato paṭik'atthato paṭalik'atthato kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇo sauttaracchado ubhato-lohitak'ūpadhāno

25316.meaning1: spread with fleece; (comm) spread with long-haired black cover

examples.text: kodhano'yaṃ, bhikkhave, purisapuggalo kodh'ābhibhūto kodhapareto, kiñ'c'āpi so pallaṅke seti gonak'atthate paṭalik'atthate kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇe sauttaracchade ubhato-lohitak'ūpadhāne, atha kho so dukkhaññ'eva seti kodh'ābhibhūto.
tatr'assa pallaṅko gonak'atthato paṭik'atthato paṭalik'atthato kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇo sauttaracchado ubhato lohitak'ūpadhāno

25317.commentary: (THa) gunnaṃ viya naṅgulaṃ naṅguṭṭhaṃ etesan'ti gonaṅgulā, kāḷamakkaṭā, pakatimakkaṭā'ti'pi vadanti'y'eva.

examples.text: acchodikā puthusilā, gonaṅgulamig'āyutā, ambusevālasañchannā, te selā ramayanti man'ti.

25319.meaning2: sited informally in an unfenced settlement(?) (as cows settle? or like encampments of cowherds (nomads) ? or among the cattle ?)

25320.commentary: (VINa) gonisādiniviṭṭho nāma vīthisannives'ādi-vasena anivisitvā yathā gāvo tattha tattha dve tayo nisīdanti, evaṃ tattha tattha dve tīṇi gharāni katvā niviṭṭho.

examples.text: gāmo nāma ekakuṭiko'pi gāmo, dvikuṭiko'pi gāmo, tikuṭiko'pi gāmo, catukuṭiko'pi gāmo, samanusso'pi gāmo, amanusso'pi gāmo, parikkhitto'pi gāmo, aparikkhitto'pi gāmo, gonisādiniviṭṭho'pi gāmo, yo'pi sattho atirekacatumāsaniviṭṭho so'pi vuccati gāmo.

25321.commentary: (SNPa) gunnaṃ pālanato gopo. yo hi attano gāvo pāleti, so gopo'ti vuccati. yo paresaṃ vetanena bhaṭo hutvā, so gopālako.

examples.text: bahum'pi ce sahitaṃ bhāsamāno, na takkaro hoti naro pamatto, gopo'va gāvo gaṇayaṃ paresaṃ, na bhāgavā sāmaññassa hoti.
taggha, brāhmaṇa, veḷuvanaṃ ramaṇīyañ'c'eva appasaddañ'ca appanigghosañ'ca vijanavātaṃ manussarāhasseyyakaṃ paṭisallānasāruppaṃ, yathā taṃ tumhādisehi rakkhakehi gopakehī'ti.
atha kho āyasmato ānandassa etadahosi, atippago kho tāva rājagahe piṇḍāya carituṃ. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ yena gopakamoggallānassa brāhmaṇassa kamm'anto, yena gopakamoggallāno brāhmaṇo ten'upasaṅkameyyan'ti.

25326.meaning1: with eyelashes like a cow; thirtieth of the thirty-two marks of a great man
25326.meaning2: having eye-lashes like that of a heifer

examples.text: gopakhumo kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, parittaṃ gopade udakaṃ. atha puriso āgaccheyya ghamm'ābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito.
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, parittaṃ gopadake udakaṃ.

mayam'eva arahāmāti evaṃ niyāmentovettha idaṃ dīpeti, yadi guṇamahantatāya upasaṅkamitabbo nāma hoti. yathā hi sineruṃ upanidhāya sāsapo, mahāsamuddaṃ upanidhāya gopadakaṃ, sattasu mahāsaresu udakaṃ upanidhāya ussāvabindu paritto lāmako.

25331.meaning1: to protect; to take care of (it)

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso vaṇaṃ ālimpeyya yāva'd'eva gopan'atthāya, seyyathā vā pana akkhaṃ abbhañjeyya yāva'd'eva bhārassa nittharaṇ'atthāya

tassa evaṃ ārakkhato gopayato te bhoge rājāno vā haranti, corā vā haranti, aggi vā dahati, udakaṃ vā vahati, appiyā vā dāy'ādā haranti. so socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃ kandati, sammohaṃ āpajjati, yam'pi me ahosi tam'pi no n'atthī'ti.

25334.meaning1: leader of the cattle; leader of the herd

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, gopālako… na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti, na titthaṃ jānāti, na pītaṃ jānāti, na vīthiṃ jānāti, na gocarakusalo hoti, anavasesadohī ca hoti, ye te usabhā gopitaro gopariṇāyakā te na atirekapūjāya pūjetā hoti.
so paṭhamaṃ patāresi ye te usabhā gopitaro gopariṇāyakā. te tiriyaṃ gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamaṃsu. ath'āpare patāresi balavagāvo dammagāvo.

25335.meaning1: cattle and livestock; (comm) cattle and sheep

examples.text: ṭhānañ'h'etaṃ, āvuso, vijjati, yaṃ amusmiṃ cātumahāpathe manussā vā atikkameyyuṃ, gopasū vā atikkameyyuṃ, vāt'ātapo vā snehagataṃ pariyādiyeyya, atha puna'd'eva rajo pātubhaveyyā'ti.

25336.meaning1: beam; rafter; wooden framework of a thatch roof

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma jarasālāya gopāṇasiyo oluggaviluggā bhavanti, evam'ev'assu me phāsuḷiyo oluggaviluggā bhavanti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.

idha, bhikkhave, tam'eva bhaginiṃ passeyya aparena samayena āsītikaṃ vā nāvutikaṃ vā vassasatikaṃ vā jātiyā, jiṇṇaṃ gopānasivaṅkaṃ bhoggaṃ daṇḍaparāyanaṃ pavedhamānaṃ gacchantiṃ āturaṃ gatayobbanaṃ khaṇḍadantaṃ palitakesaṃ, vilūnaṃ khalitasiraṃ valinaṃ tilak'āhatagattaṃ.

25338.meaning1: beam; rafter; wooden framework of a thatch roof
25338.meaning2: bent beam supporting the framework of a roof

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, kūṭ'āgārassa yā kāci gopānasiyo sabbā tā kūṭaṅ'gamā kūṭaninnā kūṭasamosaraṇā, kūṭaṃ tāsaṃ aggam'akkhāyati
āsītikaṃ vā nāvutikaṃ vā vassasatikaṃ vā jātiyā jiṇṇaṃ gopānasivaṅkaṃ bhoggaṃ daṇḍaparāyaṇaṃ pavedhamānaṃ gacchantaṃ

25340.commentary: (SNPa) gunnaṃ pālanato gopo. yo hi attano gāvo pāleti, so gopo'ti vuccati. yo paresaṃ vetanena bhaṭo hutvā, so gopālako.

examples.text: yathā daṇḍena gopālo, gāvo pājeti gocaraṃ, evaṃ jarā ca maccu ca, āyuṃ pājenti pāṇinaṃ.
gopālo supparodho ca, hiri netti ca mandiyo, pañcālacaṇḍo āḷavako, pajjunno sumano sumukho, dadhimukho maṇi māṇivaro dīgho, atho serīsako saha.

25342.grammar: masc, agent, comp, dimin of gopāla
25342.commentary: (SNPa) gunnaṃ pālanato gopo. yo hi attano gāvo pāleti, so gopo'ti vuccati. yo paresaṃ vetanena bhaṭo hutvā, so gopālako.

examples.text: gopālako sāyanhasamaye sāmikānaṃ gāvo niyyātetvā iti paṭisañcikkhati, ajja kho gāvo amukasmiñ'ca amukasmiñ'ca padese cariṃsu
ekādasahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato gopālako abhabbo gogaṇaṃ pariharituṃ phātiṃ kātuṃ. katamehi ekādasahi?

25344.meaning1: cowherd's observance day; (comm) observing together with cowherds

examples.text: so tena abhijjhāsahagatena cetasā divasaṃ atināmeti. evaṃ kho visākhe, gopālak'uposatho hoti. evaṃ upavuttho kho, visākhe, gopālak'uposatho na mahapphalo hoti na mah'ānisaṃso na mahājutiko na mahāvipphāro.
idh'eva, bhante, kapilavatthusmiṃ gopikā nāma sakyadhītā ahosi buddhe pasannā dhamme pasannā saṅghe pasannā sīlesu paripūrakārinī.
adinnaṃ nāmaṃ yaṃ adinnaṃ anissaṭṭhaṃ apariccattaṃ rakkhitaṃ gopitaṃ mamāyitaṃ parapariggahitaṃ. etaṃ adinnaṃ nāma.

25350.meaning1: father of the cattle; father of the herd

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, gopālako… na dhūmaṃ kattā hoti, na titthaṃ jānāti, na pītaṃ jānāti, na vīthiṃ jānāti, na gocarakusalo hoti, anavasesadohī ca hoti, ye te usabhā gopitaro gopariṇāyakā te na atirekapūjāya pūjetā hoti.
so paṭhamaṃ patāresi ye te usabhā gopitaro gopariṇāyakā. te tiriyaṃ gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamaṃsu. ath'āpare patāresi balavagāvo dammagāvo.

25353.meaning2: woman herding the cows or the wife of a cowherd

25354.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of gopītaka
25354.meaning1: sipping like a cow; drinking like a cow
25354.construction:
go + pīta + ka + aṃ
gopītaka + aṃ
25354.commentary: (ANa) gopītakaṃ pivitvā'ti gāviyo viya mukhena ākaḍḍhento pivitvā.

examples.text: yaṃnūn'āhaṃ catukkuṇḍiko nipatitvā gopītakaṃ pivitvā pakkameyyan'ti. so catukkuṇḍiko nipatitvā gopītakaṃ pivitvā pakkameyya.

25356.meaning2: should be guarded, should be protected, should be watched

examples.text: nagaraṃ yathā paccantaṃ, guttaṃ santarabāhiraṃ, evaṃ gopetha attānaṃ, khaṇo vo mā upaccagā, khaṇ'ātītā hi socanti, nirayamhi samappitā.

25359.meaning1: to guard; to watch; to protect

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena ambapālakā bhikkhūnaṃ ambaphalaṃ denti. bhikkhū, gopetuṃ ime issarā, na'y'ime dātun'ti, kukkuccāyantā na paṭiggaṇhanti.

25360.meaning2: having guarded, having protected, having watched

examples.text: so n'ātidūre pādaṃ uddharati, n'āccāsanne pādaṃ nikkhipati, so n'ātisīghaṃ gacchati, n'ātisaṇikaṃ gacchati, na ca adduvena adduvaṃ saṅghaṭṭento gacchati, na ca gopphakena gopphakaṃ saṅghaṭṭento gacchati.

aññena hatth'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena pād'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena gopphak'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena jaṅgh'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena ūru'ṭṭhikaṃ aññena kaṭi'ṭṭhikaṃ aññena phāsuk'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena piṭṭhi'ṭṭhikaṃ aññena khandh'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena gīv'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena hanuk'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena dant'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena sīsakaṭāhaṃ

puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu seyyathā'pi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikāni apagatasambandhāni disā vidisā vikkhittāni, aññena hatth'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena pād'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena gopphak'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena jaṅgh'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena ūru'ṭṭhikaṃ aññena kaṭi'ṭṭhikaṃ aññena phāsuk'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena piṭṭhi'ṭṭhikaṃ aññena khandh'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena gīv'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena hanuk'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena dant'aṭṭhikaṃ aññena sīsakaṭāhaṃ.
hoti kho so, āvuso, samayo yaṃ mahāsamudde aḍḍhaporisam'pi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, kaṭimattam'pi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, jāṇukamattam'pi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti, gopphakamattam'pi udakaṃ saṇṭhāti.

25369.commentary: (SNa) gobhattampī'ti dhaññaphalassa abhāvena lāyitvā kalāpakalāpaṃ bandhitvā ṭhapitaṃ gimhakāle gunnam'pi khādanaṃ bhavissatī'ti attho.

examples.text: antamaso gobhattam'pi bhavissatī'ti.
dīgharattaṃ vo, bhikkhave, gunnaṃ sataṃ gobhūtānaṃ sīsacchinnānaṃ lohitaṃ passannaṃ paggharitaṃ, na tv'eva catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakaṃ.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā āḷaviyaṃ viharati gomagge siṃsapāvane paṇṇasanthare.
gomaṇḍalaparibyūḷhaṃ, nārīvaragaṇ'āyutaṃ, uḷāraṃ mānusaṃ bhogaṃ, abhijjhāyiṃsu brāhmaṇā.

25373.meaning2: surrounded by a herds of cows

25374.commentary: (SNa) gohi tath'evā'ti yathā puttimā puttehi, tathā gosāmiko'pi sampannaṃ gomaṇḍalaṃ disvā gāvo nissāya gorasasampattiṃ anubhavamāno gohi nandati.

examples.text: nandati puttehi puttimā, gomā gohi tath'eva nandati, upadhīhi narassa nandanā, na hi so nandati yo nirūpadhī'ti.
atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ gomayapiṇḍaṃ pāṇinā gahetvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca. ettako'pi kho, bhikkhu, attabhāvapaṭilābho n'atthi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo sassatisamaṃ tath'eva ṭhassati.
so tattha allāni c'eva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya, allāni ca gomayāni pakkhipeyya, allāni ca kaṭṭhāni pakkhipeyya, udakavātañ'ca dadeyya, paṃsukena ca okireyya.
kiñ'c'āpi taṃ hoti vatthaṃ parisuddhaṃ pariyodātaṃ, atha khv'assa hoti y'eva anusahagato ūsagandho vā khāragandho vā gomayagandho vā asamūhato. tam'enaṃ rajako sāmikānaṃ deti.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, yaṃ yadeva paccayaṃ paṭicca aggi jalati tena ten'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati… tiṇañ'ca paṭicca aggi jalati, tiṇ'aggitv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati, gomayañ'ca paṭicca aggi jalati, gomay'aggitv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati

25378.meaning1: lump of cowdung; ball of cowpat
25378.commentary: (SNa) parittaṃ gomayapiṇḍan'ti appamattakaṃ madhukapupphappamāṇaṃ gomayakhaṇḍaṃ. kuto pan'ānen'etaṃ laddhan'ti. paribhaṇḍakaraṇ'atthāya ābhatato gahitan'ti eke. atthassa pana viññāpan'atthaṃ iddhiyā abhisaṅkharitvā hatth'āruḷhaṃ katan'ti veditabban'ti.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā parittaṃ gomayapiṇḍaṃ pāṇinā gahetvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavoca, ettako'pi kho, bhikkhu, attabhāvapaṭilābho n'atthi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo sassatisamaṃ tath'eva ṭhassati.

25379.meaningLit: discourse on the lump of cow-dung

examples.text: so sākabhakkho'pi hoti sāmākabhakkho'pi hoti nīvārabhakkho'pi hoti daddulabhakkho'pi hoti haṭabhakkho'pi hoti kaṇabhakkho'pi hoti ācāmabhakkho'pi hoti piññākabhakkho'pi hoti tiṇabhakkho'pi hoti gomayabhakkho'pi hoti, vanamūlaphal'āhāro'pi yāpeti pavattaphalabhojī.

te tattha sākabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, sāmākabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, nīvārabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, daddulabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, haṭabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, kaṇabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, ācāmabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, piññākabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, tiṇabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, gomayabhakkhā'pi ahesuṃ, vanamūlaphal'āhārā yāpesuṃ pavattaphalabhojī.
nandati puttehi puttimā, gomiko gohi tath'eva nandati, upadhī hi narassa nandanā, na hi so nandati yo nirūpadhi.
yathā, mahārāja, duggandham'pi gomuttaṃ pītaṃ virasam'pi agadaṃ khāyitaṃ sattānaṃ byādhiṃ hanati, evam'eva kho, mahārāja, pharusā'pi tathāgatassa vācā atthavatī karuṇāsahagatā.

25387.meaning1: yoke of oxen; team of oxen
25387.commentary: (DNa) goyugehī'ti goyuttehi satamattehi vā sahassamattehi vā yugehi.

examples.text: sace p'āyasmantānaṃ licchavīnaṃ evam'assa, mayaṃ acelaṃ pāthikaputtaṃ varattāhi bandhitvā goyugehi āviñcheyyāmā'ti, tā varattā chijjeyyuṃ pāthikaputto vā.
tattha gomaṇḍalaparibyūḷhan'ti goyūthehi parikiṇṇaṃ.

25389.meaning1: fig tree where cows are tied

examples.text: addasā kho bhagavā goyogapilakkhasmiṃ piṇḍāya caramāno aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ ritt'assādaṃ bāhir'assādaṃ muṭṭhassatiṃ asampajānaṃ asamāhitaṃ vibbhantacittaṃ pākat'indriyaṃ.

25390.commentary: (MNa) gorakkhan'ti attano vā paresaṃ vā gāvo rakkhitvā pañcagorasavikkayena jīvanakammaṃ.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, kulaputto yena sippaṭṭhānena jīvikaṃ kappeti, yadi muddāya yadi gaṇanāya yadi saṅkhānena yadi kasiyā yadi vaṇijjāya yadi gorakkhena yadi issatthena yadi rājaporisena yadi sipp'aññatarena.

yathā, mahārāja, mahiyā rājaputtānaṃ hatthi-assaratha-dhanu-tharu-lekha-muddā-sikkhā-khagga-manta-suti-sammuti-yuddha-yujjhāpana-kiriyā karaṇīyā, avasesānaṃ puthu-vessa-suddānaṃ kasi vaṇijjā gorakkhā karaṇīyā

25392.notes: pañcagorasa 1. khīraṃ, 2. dadhiṃ, 3. takkaṃ, 4. navanītaṃ, 5. sappiṃ

25393.commentary: (MNa) mātugoravakena vuyhamāno'ti mātā purato purato huṃhun'ti goravaṃ katvā saññaṃ dadamānā urena udakaṃ chindamānā gacchati, vacchako tāya goravasaññāya dhenuyā vā urena chinn'odakena gacchamāno mātugoravakena vuyhamāno'ti vuccati.

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, vacchako taruṇako tāva'd'eva jātako mātugoravakena vuyhamāno, so'pi tiriyaṃ gaṅgāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ agamāsi.

te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… hatthilakkhaṇaṃ assalakkhaṇaṃ mahiṃsalakkhaṇaṃ usabhalakkhaṇaṃ golakkhaṇaṃ ajalakkhaṇaṃ meṇḍalakkhaṇaṃ kukkuṭalakkhaṇaṃ vaṭṭakalakkhaṇaṃ godhālakkhaṇaṃ
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe. tena kho pana samayena goliyāni nāma bhikkhu āraññiko padasamācāro saṅghamajjhe osaṭo hoti kenaci'd'eva karaṇīyena.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe. tena kho pana samayena golissāni nāma bhikkhu āraññiko padasamācāro saṅghamajjhe osaṭo hoti kenaci'd'eva karaṇīyena.
